reviews.text: Tania is the most incredible, the most magnificent person on this planet 🥰 (as for the others, I don't have any information yet...). Her work reflects her: courage, firmness, and gentleness combined, intelligence and professionalism, attentiveness and kindness. Go see her without hesitation! (uh... watch your step...) 😄 I recommend her 2000%!

A huge thank you to Tania for taking such good care of our little Figo and for helping us make our stay in Marseille unforgettable. In addition to her warm welcome and attentiveness, Tania made us feel completely at ease, as we weren't used to being separated from Figo. I highly recommend her. Thanks again, and until next time! :)

I adopted a 5-year-old female dog from a shelter. She's very fearful of humans due to mistreatment. Tania took care of her, and me too, with great patience and professionalism. I'd never had a dog before, and these sessions were a huge help.

Tania is an excellent trainer, very attentive, and she has a real connection with dogs. Sia and we, her owners, have benefited greatly from her valuable advice, which we continue to follow.

I highly recommend her.

I contacted Tania after a violent accident between my dog ​​and another dog. Tania was able to reassure and train us (my dog ​​and me), but above all, she taught me to understand and listen to my dog, to anticipate her behavior, and to be attuned to her stress and my own (especially mine!!!) in order to better understand her/my reactions.
She's a wonderful person who understands our beloved pets but, most importantly, knows how to communicate with owners. I've already recommended her to other owners who are delighted! Thank you, Tania, and Viky, you too, "Thank you, Auntie :)"

I discovered Tania through Instagram.

Due to health reasons, I had to entrust my dog ​​to someone else, and it was only natural that I turned to Tania. My dog ​​had never been in anyone else's care before.

I met her once before she went to board her for a week.

I absolutely don't regret my decision.

It did my dog ​​a world of good. She was pampered, and at the same time, Tania worked with her, as she's quite responsive.

Everything went wonderfully. Every day I received updates on her day through videos, photos, and voice messages.

Now I feel completely at ease because I know who I can safely entrust my dog ​​to.

I'm eager to start lessons with Tania so we can move forward on a peaceful path together.

I highly recommend contacting Tania.

Thank you again 🙏🏻

Tania is a kind, passionate, and dedicated trainer, but above all, she's a great listener! In addition to taking care of her "students," as she calls our beloved pups, she also takes care of the owners! She's the only one who truly understood my partner's anxieties and fears, worked extensively with her, and even answers our questions when she's not working, at any time of day or night, to reassure us and offer advice!

In short, she's fantastic, and Saïyan adores his trainer!

Thank you for this excellent support!

Thank you again for your professionalism, kindness, and invaluable advice, which allowed me to move forward with my dog's training with much greater confidence!
